selection: Five distinct mineral species and one natural-water resource extend primary-evidence coverage: goldmanite and haradaite have separately scoped synthesis experiments; pentagonite has species-specific heating and pressure observations; voltaite and pertlikite support qualified identity/structure records; seawater supports laboratory microbial uranium immobilization. No mineral inherits constituent criticality or a microbial mechanism. Current and historical authority, specimen, experiment and resource scopes remain separate.

source_issues.body:
The qualified `data/records/seawater.yaml` preserves unresolved mass accounting in [Yuan et al. (2019), DOI 10.1002/advs.201900961](https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.201900961), Section 2.5, Figure 6 and supporting Table S2. This follow-up concerns unavailable source evidence; the record accepts only the narrower laboratory immobilization observation.

Table S2 reports seawater uranium as 3.10 micrograms/kg, final dry cells as 213.89 mg/kg, and initial culture normalization as 9456.59 mg/kg. Dividing the last value by the seawater concentration in the same units gives approximately 3.05 million, not the printed initial-culture ratio 625746.40. The headline 9.46 +/- 0.39 mg/g uses initial cultures, with initial medium included in the discussion, and must not be compared as final-biomass capacity. No corrected value is inferred.

The 48-hour assay uses 1 L natural seawater outside a dialysis tube containing 1 mL seawater, 10 microlitres of culture and 40 mg nutrients. Figure 6b does not show a matched no-cell uranium time course. Figure 6e's no-cell comparison concerns surface fouling. Nutrient uranium blanks, membrane sorption, final compartment uranium inventories, and cellular washing/digestion detail remain unresolved. The paper describes beach-sand strain isolation, while GenBank SNVA00000000.1 says seawater; neither specifies the assay-water collection site.

Acceptance:

- Obtain authoritative clarification or underlying replicate data for initial/final biomass, medium accounting, units, uncertainty and concentration ratios.
- Inspect matched no-cell/nutrient/membrane controls and compartment mass balance before attributing all removal to cell binding or reporting an isolated recovery yield.
- Resolve collection metadata where possible; keep strain provenance separate from assay-water provenance.
- Retain current qualifications until primary evidence supports an update. Any record change needs a canonical EDIT history and independent successor review of final bytes.

Complete published XML, nine-page supplement, Figures 3/4/6 and current NCBI strain accessions were inspected. Acquisition details and hashes are in the round100 seawater source dossier. Searches included all 253 state-inclusive issues and hidden/ignored repository records, research, reviews, history and reports; no pre-existing matching issue was found in that bounded search. Do not infer an industrial process or a specific protein from the current evidence.
source_issues.title: Clarify seawater uranium culture normalization and compartment mass accounting

source_issues.body:
The accepted `data/records/voltaite.yaml` retains an unresolved composition/refinement discrepancy in Zhitova et al. (2023), DOI [10.3390/sym15122126](https://doi.org/10.3390/sym15122126). This is a source-evidence follow-up, not a claim that the qualified identity record is invalid.

In the complete primary PDF, Table 4 (page 9) reports Ni4225 with NH4 0.11, Na 0.07 and K 0.82 per formula unit, and SCCIII-14-20s with NH4 0.14, Na 0.04 and K 0.84: totals of 1.00 and 1.02 monovalent cations. The stated ideal formula and the fully occupied crystallographic A site imply two. Table 2 (page 6) also gives fitted N/K occupancies 0.365/0.635 for Ni4225, differing substantially from Table 4's chemical NH4/K ratio 12/88 (excluding Na); these must not be pooled into one exact composition. The authors calculate Fe oxidation states by charge balance, assign water stoichiometrically, and normalize these unpolished analyses to 100 wt.%.

Acceptance:

- Obtain authoritative clarification or deposited source data for the Table 4 normalization and monovalent-cation accounting.
- Retrieve and inspect the named CIF deposits 2303617 (Ni4225) and 2303618 (SCCIII-14-20s), preserving exact versions and hashes; verify occupancy/formula conventions rather than treating accession metadata as raw measurements.
- Establish whether the difference reflects formula normalization, measured chemistry versus a selected structural crystal, vacancy treatment, or a transcription error. Do not silently double values or assert a cause without evidence.
- Retain the near-equal Fe/Mg boundary for SCCIII-14-20s and distinguish direct EDS observations from charge-balance and stoichiometric assignments.
- Any accepted record update requires a new EDIT sidecar and independent successor scientific review of the final bytes. Do not infer a microbial mechanism or recovery yield.

The current investigation searched all 253 state-inclusive repository issues plus records, research, reviews, history and scoped raw downloads including hidden/ignored files; no matching pre-existing issue was found. The original PDF is retained outside the repository with acquisition metadata in the round100 sulfate source dossier. Initial CCDC routes returned 404, and no raw diffraction refinement was reproduced.
source_issues.title: Resolve voltaite composition and structural-site normalization discrepancy

publication_review_issues.body:
Independent publication review found a minor output-safety defect in the temporary round100 coverage verification helper. The six scientific records are unaffected.

`/private/tmp/cmm-round100-isolated-coverage.py` tested `output.exists()` and then used `write_text()`. A dangling output symlink passes that existence test and is followed by the write; a competing creator can also occupy the path between the test and write. The wrapper's earlier checks reduce ordinary exposure but do not make the child write exclusive.

Initial review: `reviews/publication/20261015-round100/20261015T184111Z-publication-helpers-independent.{json,md}`. Stable review issue key: `CMMMech:round100:coverage-receipt-exclusivity`. Reviewed helper SHA256: `a7233d12b1f245d4c073933da755765d63d02dcdb15359797557fa6c4f9506ca`.

Acceptance:

- Preserve the reviewed helper and initial audit as historical evidence.
- Refuse existing regular files and symlinks, including dangling links, and create receipts with exclusive file creation.
- Test successful creation, existing-file preservation, existing and dangling symlinks, and a competing creator.
- Independently recheck the exact corrected helper and test results; save a linked successor disposition before publication.
- Re-run actual exact-hash scientific coverage with the corrected helper and retain the resulting receipt.
publication_review_issues.title: Make round100 coverage verification receipts exclusive

publication_review_issues.body:
The homepage labels aggregate mechanism counts as biological, although the curated corpus includes explicitly abiotic mechanisms. This batch makes the discrepancy concrete: goldmanite contributes two abiotic synthesis mechanisms, haradaite one, pentagonite two, and seawater one microbial mechanism. The total rises 490 to 496 and materials with mechanisms 401 to 405; those totals are not exclusively biological.

Maintained owner: `src/cmmmech/templates/index.html`, especially the statistics labels and process-section heading/prose. `scripts/render_pages.py` correctly computes all-mechanism totals; counting logic need not change. The same homepage also states every material has ChEBI and NCBI Taxonomy identifiers, although identifiers are optional and ungrounded mappings are deliberately absent from these new mineral records.

Independent initial audit: `reviews/publication/20261015-round100/20261015T185056Z-homepage-labels-initial.{json,md}`; stable issue key `CMMMech:round100:homepage-mechanism-labels`. The finding is minor and affects presentation, not scientific owner content.

Acceptance:

- Use neutral mechanism labels and state that curated processes include biological and abiotic evidence.
- Describe identifier mappings as present where verified, rather than promising ChEBI and NCBI Taxonomy for every record.
- Keep all six material-kind boundaries explicit, including primary resources, without changing source records or counting logic.
- Regenerate `pages/index.html`, run the affected rendering checks, and independently review the exact template/rendered correction with a successor linked to the initial audit.
- Preserve all frozen scientific owners, histories and reviews.
publication_review_issues.title: Distinguish all curated mechanisms from biological mechanisms on homepage

corrective_findings: No supported corrective scientific finding remained; falsified review hypotheses are retained in review notes. Source-evidence limitations are tracked separately.
